turn.content: The coffee machine (line 1) was ordered on PO-2026-0055 but the only goods receipt (GR-2026-0055) covers only the 20 kg coffee powder — the machine was never received. No earlier invoice bills this PO. So the machine hasn't been delivered/received at all, not billed before.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "quantity_exceeds_received", "line": 1, "cause": "short_delivery", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0055", "detail": "Line 1 orders 1 unit of 'Mesin Kopi Otomatis' at 6430900, matching the invoiced quantity and price."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0055", "detail": "The only goods receipt against PO-2026-0055 records just the 20 kg of Kopi Bubuk Arabika; the coffee machine is not on it, so received quantity for line 1 is 0."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-015#4.2", "detail": "Vendor may only invoice goods actually received and recorded in a berita acara penerimaan."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-015#7.2", "detail": "Partial deliveries are allowed; the remaining goods are shipped and invoiced after receipt."}, {"kind": "vendor", "ref": "V-015", "detail": "No earlier ledger invoice by this vendor references PO-2026-0055, so this is not a rebilling."}], "explanation": "The coffee machine on line 1 was ordered but never delivered — the only goods receipt for PO-2026-0055 covers the coffee powder alone — so the invoice bills goods not yet received, a short delivery."}]}
